name: Serathil
bonuses: Hardened Skin (passive): reduces physical damage from attacks by 8% (doubled below 20% health).
description: Grants +16 Strength, +5 damage, and +500 maximum health. Hardened Skin reduces physical damage from attacks by 8%, doubled below 20% health. Doesn't stack.

name: Killmaim
bonuses: Vampiric Aura (aura): causes nearby friendly melee units' attacks to restore health equal to 33% (50% self) of damage dealt.
description: Grants +6 Strength, +6 all stats, +14 damage, and +200 maximum health. Vampiric Aura causes nearby friendly melee units' attacks to restore health equal to 33% of damage dealt, or 50% for self.

name: Searing Blade
bonuses: Command Aura (aura): increases nearby friendly units' damage by 8% (12% self).
description: Grants +4 all stats, +18 damage, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.025 seconds. Command Aura increases nearby friendly units' damage by 8%, or 12% for self.

name: Firehand Gauntlets
bonuses: Fervor (passive): attacks increase attack speed by 5%, movement speed by 2% but reduce damage by 5% per every stack for 5 sec. Stacks up to 8 times.
description: Grants +6 Agility, +4 all stats, +10 damage, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.10 seconds. Fervor increases attack speed by 5% and movement speed by 2%, but reduces damage by 5% per stack for 5 seconds. Stacks up to 8 times.

name: Talisman of Evasion
bonuses: Avoidance (passive): increases Evasion chance by 15% (12% for ranged).
description: Grants +16 Agility, +5 damage, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.08 seconds. Avoidance increases evasion chance by 15%, or 12% for ranged. Doesn't stack.

name: Eagleeye
bonuses: Trueshot Aura (aura): increases nearby friendly ranged units' damage by 10% (15% self).
description: Grants +6 Agility, +6 all stats, +14 damage, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.03 seconds. Trueshot Aura increases nearby friendly ranged units' damage by 10%, or 15% for self.

name: Shield of Honor
bonuses: Devotion Aura (aura): increases nearby friendly units' armor by 2 (+1 for each 20 base armor).
description: Grants +4 all stats, +6 armor, and +550 maximum health. Devotion Aura increases nearby friendly units' armor by 2, plus 1 for each 20 base armor.

name: Kraken Shell
bonuses: Spiked Carapace (passive): returns 5% (+1% for each 10 armor) physical damage back to melee attackers.
description: Grants +4 all stats, +12 armor, and +200 maximum health. Spiked Carapace returns 5% physical damage back to melee attackers, plus 1% for each 10 armor. Doesn't stack.

name: Archmage Staff
bonuses: Brilliance Aura (aura): increases nearby friendly units' mana regeneration by 0.2% (0.3% self) maximum mana per sec.
description: Grants +16 Intelligence, +350 maximum mana, and +50% mana regeneration. Brilliance Aura increases nearby friendly units' mana regeneration by 0.2% maximum mana per second, or 0.3% for self.

name: Skull of Gul'dan
bonuses: Necromancy (passive): increases summoned units' base attack damage, their ability damage by 25% and reduces their spell damage taken by 30%.
description: Grants +6 Intelligence, +6 all stats, +425 maximum health, +125 maximum mana, and +50% mana regeneration. Necromancy increases summoned units' base attack damage and ability damage by 25%, and reduces their spell damage taken by 30%. Doesn't stack.

name: Scepter of Purification
bonuses: Purification (passive): increases healing generated through spells, abilities and items by 40% except regenerations.
description: Grants +6 Intelligence, +325 maximum health, +150 maximum mana, and +100% mana regeneration. Purification increases healing generated through spells, abilities, and items by 40%, except regenerations. Doesn't stack.

name: Bloodhoof Totem
bonuses: Titan's Might (passive): increases strength by 10% but reduces agility by 8%.
description: Grants +10 Strength, +4 all stats, +5 damage, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.08 seconds. Titan's Might increases strength by 10% but reduces agility by 8%. Doesn't stack.

name: Furymourne
bonuses: Berserk (passive): attacks have 25% chance to increase damage by 75% (melee) / 60% (ranged) but reduce armor by 5 for 6 sec.
description: Grants +7 Strength, +20 damage, +200 maximum health, and -15% attack speed. Berserk gives attacks a 25% chance to increase damage by 75% for melee or 60% for ranged, but reduces armor by 5 for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

name: Wand of the Deathlord
bonuses: Finger of Death (active): consumes 20% caster's health and mana to deal spell damage to target equal to 2x health consumed and 3x mana consumed. Resets cooldown on killing a target.
description: Grants +10 Intelligence, +6 all stats, +300 maximum health, and +200 maximum mana. Finger of Death consumes 20% of the caster's health and mana to deal spell damage equal to 2x health consumed and 3x mana consumed. Resets cooldown when killing a target. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

name: Voodoo Doll
bonuses: Aura of Decay (aura): increases nearby enemy units' spell damage taken by 10%.
Doesn't stack with Amplify Magic Field
description: Grants +15 Intelligence, +400 maximum health, +125 maximum mana, and +50% mana regeneration. Aura of Decay increases nearby enemy units' spell damage taken by 10%. Doesn't stack with Amplify Magic Field.

name: Heart of Searinox
bonuses: Flurry (passive): increases agility by 10% but reduces strength by 8%.
description: Grants +10 Agility, +4 all stats, +5 damage, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.08 seconds. Flurry increases agility by 10% but reduces strength by 8%. Doesn't stack.

name: Nesingwary 4000
bonuses: Sharpshooting (passive): increases attack range by 75 and damage dealt with ranged attacks by 10%.
description: Grants +7 Agility, +17 damage, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.03 seconds. Sharpshooting increases attack range by 75 and ranged attack damage by 10%.

name: Muradin's Guardian
bonuses: Avatar (passive): damage which would kill bearer cause him to be healed for 40% health instead and increase his armor by amount of 0.5% maximum health for 15 sec. Also causes enemy melee units that attack bearer to reduce their movement speed by 40% and attack speed by 20% for 5 sec.
description: Grants +6 Strength, +6 all stats, +5 damage, and +600 maximum health. Avatar causes lethal damage to heal the bearer for 40% health instead and increases armor by 0.5% maximum health for 15 seconds. Enemy melee attackers have their movement speed reduced by 40% and attack speed reduced by 20% for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds.

name: Vanguard
bonuses: Shield Wall (passive): damage taken by bearer have 20% chance to increase his armor by 75% but reduce damage by 60% for 3 sec.
description: Grants +10 Strength, +10 armor, and +325 maximum health. Shield Wall gives damage taken by the bearer a 20% chance to increase armor by 75% but reduce damage by 60% for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

name: Wizardy Rod
bonuses: Intellect (passive): increases intelligence by amount of 0.5% maximum mana.
description: Grants +7 Intelligence, +450 maximum mana, and +50% mana regeneration. Intellect increases intelligence by 0.5% of maximum mana. Doesn't stack.

name: Oblivion Orb
bonuses: Blood Pact (passive): increases intelligence by amount of 0.4% maximum health but reduces armor by 100%.
description: Grants +7 Intelligence, +500 maximum health, +125 maximum mana, and +50% mana regeneration. Blood Pact increases intelligence by 0.4% of maximum health but reduces armor by 100%. Doesn't stack.

name: Ironwood Branch
bonuses: Rejuvenation Aura (aura): restores health to nearby friendly units equal to 1% bearer's maximum mana (+0.5x Spirit level) per sec.
description: Grants +10 Intelligence, +350 maximum health, and +225 maximum mana. Rejuvenation Aura restores health to nearby friendly units equal to 1% of the bearer's maximum mana plus 0.5x Spirit level per second.

name: Helm of Valor
bonuses: Frenzy (passive): damage taken by bearer have 40% chance to increase his attack speed by 75% and movement speed by 25% for 3 sec.
description: Grants +10 Strength, +6 all stats, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.06 seconds. Frenzy gives damage taken by the bearer a 40% chance to increase attack speed by 75% and movement speed by 25% for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

name: Mjölnir
bonuses: Stormbreaker Aura (aura): reduces nearby enemy units' armor by 2.
description: Grants +8 Strength, +6 all stats, +5 damage, +175 maximum health, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.06 seconds. Stormbreaker Aura reduces nearby enemy units' armor by 2.

name: Mask of Death
bonuses: Vampirism (passive): while under 50% health, attacks restore health equal to 25% of damage dealt, increased by 3% of damage dealt per every 1% health missing.
description: Grants +6 Strength, +6 Agility, +10 damage, +500 maximum health, reduces base attack cooldown by 0.03 seconds, and reduces current health regeneration by 0.5%. Vampirism restores health from attacks while under 50% health, with half effectiveness for ranged heroes.

name: Backstab Edge
bonuses: Backstab (passive): attacks reduce target's and enemy units' around within 150 range armor by 4 for 1 sec.
description: Grants +6 Strength, +6 Agility, +4 all stats, +13 damage, +175 maximum health, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.05 seconds. Backstab reduces armor of the target and nearby enemy units by 4 for 1 second. Doesn't stack.

name: Hood of Cunning
bonuses: Anti-magic Shell (passive): reduces spell damage taken by 20% (+0.2% for each 1% Evasion chance) and spell damage which would kill bearer cause him to be shielded instead, absorbing 500 (+5 for each 1% Evasion chance) spell damage for next 15 sec.
description: Grants +10 Agility, +6 all stats, and +6 armor. Anti-magic Shell reduces spell damage taken and can shield the bearer from lethal spell damage. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

name: Kelen's Dagger
bonuses: Endurance Aura (aura): increases nearby friendly units' movement speed by 4% (6% self) and attack speed by 8% (12% self).
description: Grants +8 Agility, +6 all stats, +5 damage, and reduces base attack cooldown by 0.08 seconds. Endurance Aura increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and attack speed.

name: Helmet of Awakening
description: Grants +4 all stats, +4 armor, +700 maximum health, and +1% maximum health regeneration. Fortitude increases maximum health by 5%. Doesn't stack.

name: Hammer of Fright
bonuses: Fear (passive): attacks reduce target's and enemy units' around within 225 range damage by 15% for 2 sec.
description: Grants +6 Strength, +5 damage, +7 armor, and +500 maximum health. Fear reduces the damage of the target and nearby enemy units by 15% for 2 seconds. Doesn't stack.

name: Enchanted Shield
bonuses: Energy Shield (active): absorbs 20% damage taken draining mana equal to 50% of damage absorbed. Absorbs 40% if under 50% health. Absorbs 60% if damage taken is lethal.
description: Grants +10 Intelligence, +6 all stats, and +250 maximum mana. Energy Shield absorbs part of incoming damage by draining mana equal to 50% of damage absorbed, with stronger absorption while under 50% health or against lethal damage.

name: Khadgar's Spellbook
bonuses: Amplify Magic Field (active): places a field dealing 2% maximum mana (150 range), 1.5% maximum mana (225 range), 1% maximum mana (300 range) spell damage per sec to enemy units, reduces their movement speed by 20% and increases spell damage taken by 33% for 8 sec.
Doesn't stack with Aura of Decay
description: Grants +8 Intelligence, +6 all stats, +350 maximum mana, and +50% mana regeneration. Amplify Magic Field deals spell damage based on maximum mana, slows enemies, and increases spell damage taken for 8 seconds. Mana cost: 10% maximum mana. Cooldown: 30 seconds. Doesn't stack with Aura of Decay.

name: Heart of Aszune
bonuses: Restoration (active): restores health to nearby friendly units within 1000 range equal to 15% maximum mana (+7.5x Spirit level) (initially and over 5 sec) and increases their armor by 2% of amount healed for 5 sec.
description: Grants +6 Intelligence, +4 all stats, +4 armor, +175 maximum health, +350 maximum mana, and +50% mana regeneration. Restoration heals nearby friendly units within 1000 range based on maximum mana and Spirit level, then increases their armor by 2% of the amount healed for 5 seconds. Mana cost: 15% maximum mana. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

name: Pickaxe
description: Grants +1 Strength, +1 Agility, +1 Intelligence, and +2 damage.

name: Buckler
description: Grants +1 Strength, +1 Agility, +1 Intelligence, +1 armor, and +60 maximum health.

name: Potion of Health
bonuses: Restores 300 (+10 per level) (+20% maximum health) health over 30 sec.
description: Restores 300 health, plus 10 per level and 20% maximum health, over 30 seconds. Has 3 charges.

name: Potion of Mana
bonuses: Restores 150 (+5 per level) (+10% maximum mana) mana over 30 sec.
description: Restores 150 mana, plus 5 per level and 10% maximum mana, over 30 seconds. Has 3 charges.

name: Ankh
description: Grants +2 Strength, reduces base attack cooldown by 0.01 seconds, and increases mana regeneration by 10%.

name: Cloak
description: Grants +2 Agility, reduces base attack cooldown by 0.01 seconds, and increases mana regeneration by 10%.

name: Charm
description: Grants +2 Intelligence, +40 maximum mana, and increases mana regeneration by 10%.
